tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Job cards, sheets, inputs and chat bubbles from the other person. Sits on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised. Also the pass button's icon.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, placeholders, and the border of inputs. On surface or surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines only. Too faint for control borders; use ink-muted there.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, the apply button, links, the active tab, your own chat bubbles. Text in this colour is allowed on surface.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Chip backgrounds, selected rows, the radius circle's fill on maps. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: near
tokens.usage: Distance only: the distance chip on a job card and the 'you' dot on maps. Never used for anything that is not about proximity.

tokens.name: on-near
tokens.usage: Text on near. Dark in both themes because near does not change.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Accepted applications and confirmations, as text or icon on surface. Always with an icon or label, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, report, block and delete account, as text or icon on surface. Always with an icon or label, never colour alone.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between related lines of text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side padding, card padding, gap between list rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen; padding of the job card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, avatars, the distance chip, the round apply and pass buttons.
